@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+## #1569 - Select LLVM ar for macOS wasm builds
+
+**Chosen:** When the target-specific archiver variable is unset on macOS,
+look for `llvm-ar` on PATH, then in Homebrew's LLVM prefix, then in the
+active Rust toolchain's `llvm-tools` directory. Export the target-specific
+variable before downloading or compiling. Preserve explicit values,
+including an explicitly empty value. If discovery fails, name `llvm-ar`
+and both installation choices in an early refusal.
+
+**Why:** Apple's archive tools cannot index the wasm objects used by flecs.
+Target-specific selection keeps native archiving unchanged. Dynamic prefixes
+work with Intel, Apple silicon, and custom Homebrew installations.
+
+**Dropped:** A hardcoded Homebrew prefix misses other installations. Setting
+global `AR` could change native builds. Waiting for the linker to fail gives
+the user undefined-symbol errors rather than the missing-tool diagnosis.
+
+**Cost to change later:** The discovery block is isolated in the wasm build
+script. Its seven hermetic regression cases run with `/bin/bash` and fake
+toolchains, without downloads or compilation.

     else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
 }
 
+# Apple's ar/ranlib cannot index flecs' wasm objects. Select a target-only
+# LLVM archiver before downloading or building; keep explicit overrides.
+if [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Darwin" && -z "${AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown+x}" ]]; then
+    wasm_ar="$(command -v llvm-ar || true)"
+    if [[ -z "$wasm_ar" ]] && command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        llvm_prefix="$(brew --prefix llvm 2>/dev/null || true)"
+        if [[ -n "$llvm_prefix" && -x "$llvm_prefix/bin/llvm-ar" ]]; then
+            wasm_ar="$llvm_prefix/bin/llvm-ar"
+        fi
+    fi
+    if [[ -z "$wasm_ar" ]] && command -v rustc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        rust_sysroot="$(rustc --print sysroot 2>/dev/null || true)"
+        rust_host="$(rustc -vV 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^host: //p' || true)"
+        rust_ar="$rust_sysroot/lib/rustlib/$rust_host/bin/llvm-ar"
+        if [[ -n "$rust_sysroot" && -n "$rust_host" && -x "$rust_ar" ]]; then
+            wasm_ar="$rust_ar"
+        fi
+    fi
+    [[ -n "$wasm_ar" ]] || die "macOS wasm builds need llvm-ar: run brew install llvm or rustup component add llvm-tools, or set AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown to llvm-ar"
+    export AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown="$wasm_ar"
+fi
+
 TOOLS="$ROOT/target/wasm-tools"
 mkdir -p "$TOOLS"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Exercise archiver selection before the wasm build downloads or compiles."""
+# Provenance: regression cases for #1569, using isolated fake toolchains.
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+
+class WasmArchiver(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="wasm-ar-")
+        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
+        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
+        self.bin = self.root / "bin"
+        self.bin.mkdir()
+        (self.bin / "dirname").symlink_to("/usr/bin/dirname")
+        (self.bin / "sed").symlink_to("/usr/bin/sed")
+        self.env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
+                    if not key.startswith("AR")}
+        self.env.update(PATH=str(self.bin), TEST_OS="Darwin")
+        self.tool("uname", 'printf "%s\\n" "$TEST_OS"')
+        source = Path(__file__).with_name("build-app-wasm.sh").read_text()
+        self.script = self.root / "selection.sh"
+        self.script.write_text(source.split('\nTOOLS=', 1)[0] +
+                               '\n/bin/bash -c \'printf "SELECTED=%s\\n" '
+                               '"${AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown-}"\'\n')
+
+    def tool(self, name, body, directory=None):
+        path = (directory or self.bin) / name
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text("#!/bin/bash\n" + body + "\n")
+        path.chmod(0o755)
+        return str(path)
+
+    def run_selection(self):
+        return subprocess.run(["/bin/bash", str(self.script)], env=self.env,
+                              text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+
+    def selected(self, expected):
+        result = self.run_selection()
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+        self.assertIn("SELECTED=" + expected + "\n", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_macos_selects_path_llvm_ar(self):
+        ar = self.tool("llvm-ar", "exit 0")
+        self.selected(ar)
+
+    def test_macos_selects_homebrew_llvm_ar_with_spaces(self):
+        prefix = self.root / "Homebrew LLVM"
+        ar = self.tool("llvm-ar", "exit 0", prefix / "bin")
+        self.env["TEST_BREW_PREFIX"] = str(prefix)
+        self.tool("brew", '[[ "$*" == "--prefix llvm" ]] || exit 1\n'
+                          'printf "%s\\n" "$TEST_BREW_PREFIX"')
+        self.selected(ar)
+
+    def test_macos_selects_rustup_llvm_tools(self):
+        sysroot = self.root / "rust toolchain"
+        host = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
+        ar = self.tool("llvm-ar", "exit 0",
+                       sysroot / "lib" / "rustlib" / host / "bin")
+        self.env["TEST_SYSROOT"] = str(sysroot)
+        self.tool("rustc", 'case "$*" in\n'
+                          '  "--print sysroot") printf "%s\\n" "$TEST_SYSROOT" ;;\n'
+                          '  "-vV") printf "host: aarch64-apple-darwin\\n" ;;\n'
+                          '  *) exit 1 ;;\nesac')
+        self.selected(ar)
+
+    def test_preserves_explicit_target_archiver(self):
+        for platform in ("Darwin", "Linux"):
+            with self.subTest(platform=platform):
+                self.env.update(TEST_OS=platform,
+                                AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown="/custom tools/ar")
+                self.selected("/custom tools/ar")
+
+    def test_linux_does_not_choose_llvm_ar(self):
+        self.env["TEST_OS"] = "Linux"
+        self.tool("llvm-ar", "exit 0")
+        self.selected("")
+
+    def test_preserves_explicit_empty_target_archiver(self):
+        self.env["AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown"] = ""
+        self.tool("llvm-ar", "exit 0")
+        self.selected("")
+
+    def test_macos_refuses_without_llvm_ar(self):
+        result = self.run_selection()
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout)
+        self.assertIn("llvm-ar", result.stderr)
+        self.assertIn("brew install llvm", result.stderr)
+        self.assertIn("rustup component add llvm-tools", result.stderr)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
